## Purpose

Describe the change and the participant or user group outcome it supports.

## Publication Status

- [ ] Draft or internal review
- [ ] Ready for public review
- [ ] Speaker or contributor approval received where required

## Quality Gate

- [ ] No secrets, private information, attendee data, or production data
- [ ] Synthetic or fully de-identified examples only
- [ ] Links and Markdown rendering checked
- [ ] Accessibility reviewed
- [ ] Sources and authors credited
- [ ] No legal, regulatory, compliance, audit, or tax guidance
- [ ] Publication rights confirmed
